# Interceptor-chain overhead results

Source: [`latest.json`](./latest.json), generated 2026-10-18T21:57:45Z, overall pass.
Method: [`chain-overhead/README.md`](./chain-overhead/README.md). To reproduce or add an outside rerun, follow [`chain-overhead/REPRODUCE.md`](./chain-overhead/REPRODUCE.md).

Every figure is the added latency of a Gavio stack over a raw provider call that simulates 5 ms. p50 and p95 are nearest-rank percentiles of 200 interleaved iterations after 20 warm-up iterations, over 220 fixed payloads (`sha256:3ddd21265fcffeaac221de04419224919a6debc8564a2db73d4d822246f77b42`). **Budget** is the most p50 overhead the stack may add, as a share of the baseline.

Differences of a few tens of µs are timer noise: compare stacks by their gaps. See "Reading the numbers" in the method README.
